zh-CN: 电脑没有回应直连握手，可能在电脑上关闭了直连或防火墙拦下了请求。当前所有操作都已自动走中继，不影响正常使用。
en: The computer did not reply to the direct handshake; direct connections may be off there or blocked by a firewall. Everything currently uses relay automatically with no impact on use.
notes: 人话排障单：电脑无应答说明。

zh-CN: 电脑上安装的 remote-agent 版本暂不支持直连，更新后即可自动使用。当前所有操作都已自动走中继，不影响正常使用。
en: The remote-agent version on the computer does not support direct connections yet; update it to enable direct paths. Everything currently uses relay automatically with no impact on use.
notes: 人话排障单：电脑端版本过旧说明。

zh-CN: 本次协商没有在时限内完成，网络稳定后会自动再试。当前所有操作都已自动走中继，不影响正常使用。
en: Direct negotiation did not finish within the time budget and will retry when the network changes. Everything currently uses relay automatically with no impact on use.
notes: 人话排障单：通用未连上说明。
